BUILDING DEPARTMENT 6848 Hathaway R d . Valley View, OH 44125 Phone: 216 - 524 - 9361 | Fax: 216: 524 - 7240 The following is the process for the installation of a fence: 1. Fill out the attached application. 2. Draw a site plan and note the location of the fence and all permanent structures on the lot. SHOW ALL PROPERTY LINES AND EXISTING FENCES LOCATED ALONG PROPERTY LINES. (PLEASE DO NOT USE HIGHLIGHTER). 3. Enclose a catalog cut, a picture, or a drawing of the proposed fence with the application. 4. The plans and application will be reviewed by the Building Official, if there is no need for a variance, you will be notified by the phone number given on the application that your permit is ready for payment and pick-up. PERMIT FEE IS $35.00. Building Department Village of Valley View

BUILDING DEPARTMENT 6848 Hathaway Road Valley View, OH 44125 Phone: 216-524-9361 | Fax: 216: 524-7240 APPLICATION FOR FOOD TRUCK PERMIT In accordance with Chapter 856 of the Codified Ordinances of the Village of Valley View, in addition to a completed application, the following information must be provided: 1. A copy of a current and valid Mobile Service or Mobile Food Establishment license issued by the Cuyahoga County Board of Health or other health department in the state of Ohio possessing appropriate licensing authority. 2. Written permission from the owner or manager of the property where the food truck will operate. 3. A valid photo ID of the person applying for the permit. 4. Proof of Insurance for the truck shall be provided with this application for a permit. This permit is valid from the date listed below until December 31 st of the same year. The permit must be kept with you
